name: dogfood-pipeline-pass-2
description: Dogfood pipeline pass 2 (2026-08-04, PRs #787-#798): 12 seeds issues dispatched serially to the live warren instance on pi + openrouter/kimi-k3, 12/12 runs succeeded first try, total ~$6.16 (runs $0.16-$0.86, docs cheapest, new-gate/UI-split priciest). One DIRTY conflict (RunDetail split vs SDK-NDJSON merge on overlapping UI files) repaired by a ref-dispatch repair run ($0.22) that preserved both sides; zero seed closes lost. Serial auto-merge chase confirmed: every PR came out BEHIND after the previous merge and needed gh pr update-branch; Article IX correctly declined auto-merge on src/registry/builtins/ PRs (manually armed under standing operator auth).

Dispatching a warren run for a seed that exists only in the local working tree: the agent clone comes from origin, so 'sd show <id>' finds nothing and the run cannot close the seed (its PR diff carries no .seeds row). Always commit+push the seed row to origin BEFORE POST /runs, or accept doing the close yourself after merge.
resolution: warren-53bd run: prompt digest carried the full spec so the work succeeded; operator closed the seed manually after PR #851 merged. Session rule adopted: push seed rows before dispatch.

description: GFI batch 2026-08-16 re-confirmed the born-dead pattern: warren-c550 and warren-2e3d (filed 2026-08-15) were both fixed by 26056fe4 (PR #783) on 2026-08-04 — 11 days BEFORE filing. The rows were written from a stale mental model of the CLI, not from HEAD; c550 even contradicted the live rows 8807/2ceb, whose repro depends on the config-file read c550 claimed was missing. Also: warren-7634 died one day after filing via d4eb972c (#860) under different field names (provider/model, not providerOverride), so pickaxe searches for the row's own vocabulary can miss the killer.
resolution: Verify every tracker row against HEAD before filing outward: re-read the named code, pickaxe the behaviour's storage site (not the row's vocabulary), and when two open rows are mutually inconsistent let the code decide. Batch outcome: 4 rows closed dead/duplicate, 2 rewritten (bad5, 4001), 11 GitHub issues filed with bidirectional links.

name: campaign-plan-lift-then-wire
description: Campaign plan pl-3007 (burrow absorption + self-host, epic warren-b73f) decomposition pattern: lift-then-wire per phase (adapters lift warren-7933 before k8s rewire warren-0efe; sandbox module lift warren-5af7 before LocalProvider wiring warren-413d), token wins front-loaded as immediately-dispatchable children per ROADMAP item 4's explicit allowance, existing seeds handled three ways — adopt into plan via existing_seed (warren-0f18), dep-link to superseding child + note both sides (warren-c4f3 <- warren-572d), or dep-link to the enabling child (warren-c865/warren-fb8d <- warren-413d).

sd plan submit rejects alternatives as plain strings — the feature template requires objects {name, rejected_because}; the prompt output ('alternatives (list)') does not say so. Plan steps also carry no description field, so per-child file sets, gates, and dispatch rules cannot ride the plan JSON.
resolution: Inspect an existing row in .seeds/plans.jsonl for section shapes before filling a template; write per-child descriptions post-spawn via sd update <child> --description.

title: remove-stale-umbrella-edge-when-plan-child-concretizes
rationale: When a plan child concretizes the umbrella step a seed was parked behind, keeping both edges creates a cycle through the epic (epic blocked-by children, umbrella blocked-by epic, seed blocked-by umbrella, child blocked-by seed).

name: scope-handoff-keeps-adopted-child-outside-file-gate
description: When adopting a seed into a plan would trip a file-set gate (warren-f525's sapling batch-steering removal touches src/runtime/k8s/, which the campaign gates behind warren-fe9b/d15c/32f8), narrow the adopted child's scope to the ungated surface and hand the gated slice to the plan child already behind that gate (warren-0efe deletes the sapling branches by omission during its rewire, dep'd on f525). The adopted child stays immediately dispatchable; the gated child inherits one sentence of extra scope instead of the whole seed inheriting three blockers.
